entries.cause: Issue #1042: the 1880 ruleset tradeProtection.resourcesPerRequiredShip goes from 400 to 2000, so the TradeProtectionAssessed event body in this war replay records a lower quota, Austria-Hungary 4 to 1 at war start, which moves the event ledger checkpoint from month 3. No engine code changed.
entries.migrationAssessment: Content-only balance retune with no state shape or schema change. A save made before this change replays under the new ruleset and gets the lower quota from its next war month, so no stored value needs migration. Raider hit chance and revenue loss follow the shortfall ratio, which can only fall for an unchanged fleet.
